Ask a question ⌘I All releases September 18, 2026 v2.12.0 Scoped search keys that expire Create short lived search keys on your server that only see one customer's documents, without a request to ZeroIndex. Scoped keys are signed on your server from a parent search key, so creating one costs nothing and works offline. Each one can be limited to some indexes, carry a filter that is added to every query, and expire after up to 30 days. const key = client . keys .createScoped ({ parent : process . env . ZEROINDEX_SEARCH_KEY , indexes : [ "tickets" ] , filter : "account_id = 4821" , expiresIn : "1h" , }); Send the key to the browser and search straight from there. A user can change the query, but never the filter. More in Authenti
